I downloaded my old Tumblr posts

<!--more-->

> *I downloaded my old Tumblr posts to create some analysis like I did with my Instagram activity.*
>
> <https://www.nmoore.nz/portfolio/2026-03-17-insta-export/>
>
> *The Tumblr export is a zip file with a `media` folder of images and a `posts` folder with one HTML file per post. Each post has the image, a caption, a timestamp and the tags.*
>
> *A Python script turns the HTML into a single `posts.csv` with post id, timestamp, tags and text. The charts below come from that file.*

```{r loading, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)

fldr = './'

posts = read_csv(paste0(fldr, 'posts.csv')) |> 
    mutate(month = floor_date(timestamp, unit = 'month'))

post_tags = posts |> 
    separate_longer_delim(tags, delim = '; ') |> 
    filter(!is.na(tags))

```

## **Posts**

`r format(nrow(posts), big.mark = ',')` posts from `r format(min(posts$timestamp), '%B %Y')` to `r format(max(posts$timestamp), '%B %Y')`.

```{r postsbymonth, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

df_posts = posts |> 
    count(month)

ggplot(df_posts, aes(x=month, y=n)) + 
    geom_col(fill = 'skyblue3') +
    scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = '1 year', date_labels = '%Y') +
    theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(y = NULL) +
    ggtitle('Posts by Month')

```

```{r postsbyyear, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

df_years = posts |> 
    count(year = year(timestamp)) |> 
    complete(year = full_seq(year, 1), fill = list(n = 0))

ggplot(df_years, aes(x=factor(year), y=n)) + 
    geom_col(fill = 'salmon') +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
    ggtitle('Posts by Year')

```

## **Tags**

`r format(n_distinct(post_tags$tags), big.mark = ',')` different tags, and `r sum(is.na(posts$tags))` posts without any.

```{r toptags, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

df_tags = post_tags |> 
    count(tags) |> 
    slice_max(n, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(df_tags, aes(x=n, y=fct_reorder(tags, n))) + 
    geom_col(fill = 'rosybrown') +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
    ggtitle('Top 20 tags')

```

```{r tagtimeline, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

top_tags = df_tags |> 
    slice_max(n, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
    pull(tags)

df_tag_month = post_tags |> 
    filter(tags %in% top_tags) |> 
    count(month, tags)

ggplot(df_tag_month, aes(x=month, y=n, fill=tags)) + 
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set1') +
    scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = '1 year', date_labels = '%Y') +
    theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    ggtitle('Top tags over time')

```

#### **Top tags by year**

```{r tagsbyyear, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=10}

df_tag_year = post_tags |> 
    count(year = year(timestamp), tags) |> 
    group_by(year) |> 
    slice_max(n, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(tag_year = fct_reorder(paste(tags, year, sep = '___'), n))

ggplot(df_tag_year, aes(x=n, y=tag_year)) + 
    geom_col(fill = 'darkseagreen') +
    facet_wrap(~ year, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_remove(x, '___.*')) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
    ggtitle('Top tags by year')

```
